situations.title: Litigation Funding
situations.body: Complex disputes, contested matters, and commercial judgments awaiting recovery.
situations.details: Together with our network of capital partners and experts, Turnpage arranges and funds complex, binary and speculative litigation at all stages and many jurisdictions globally. We often work with bankruptcy trustees and liquidating trustees that lack the funding to monetize potentially valuable claims for the benefit of creditors and trust beneficiaries.

situations.title: Class Action Settlements
situations.body: Class-member rights in the the largest collective actions.
situations.details: From antitrust settlements to mass tort claims, we connect class members to competitive bids. We handle large individual positions as well as portfolios of smaller positions aggregated for efficiency.

situations.title: Bankruptcy Claims
situations.body: Trade claims, customer claims, and other interests in significant bankruptcy cases.
situations.details: Turnpage offers efficient execution and highly competitive pricing for creditors seeking to monetize their recovery rights. Our team has traded hundreds millions of dollars worth of claims in the largest chapter 11 cases and advised thousands of creditors.

situations.title: Locked Digital Assets
situations.body: Cryptocurrency, NFTs, accounts and deposits stuck in judicial proceedings.
situations.details: Digital assets locked on exchange platforms, frozen bank accounts, and deposits trapped in restructurings are all addressable. Our team has deep expertise in nearly all of the major crypto estate cases that defined this asset class—BlockFi, BlockFills, Celsius, CRED, FTX, Genesis, Mt. Gox, Terraform Labs, Three Arrows Capital, Vauld, Voyager

situations.title: Government Receivables
situations.body: IEEPA and Section 122 tariff refund rights, duty drawbacks and related receivables.
situations.details: Turnpage launched standalone platform Rewind Tariffs to serve the $166 billion market for trading IEEPA tariff refund rights and has brokered or advised on over $50 million of refund claims.  We partner seamlessly with importers, customs brokers and trade advisors to augment their services and  structure transactions to minimize counterparty risk.

situations.title: Other Illiquid Assets
situations.body: Trade receivables, seized property, and one-off complex matters by conversation.
situations.details: If your situation doesn't fit a standard category, reach out. We've structured solutions for seized property, legacy receivables, and novel asset classes that most intermediaries won't touch.

testimonials.quote: Andrew is always thinking about how to structure trades in the most elegant way to allocate risk among the parties. When others give up, Andrew digs in.
Andrew is extremely professional and easy to work with. His negotiating style is collaborative rather than confrontational, but he knows how to dial it up for a client when the situation demands.
Andrew has deep knowledge about bankruptcy and restructuring that gives his clients a major advantage in negotiations.
